title: Repository context budget v1
description: What a repository puts into an agent's context before any run, in characters, from the tree alone: no LLM call (docs/repo-evaluation-contract.md, `repo budget`). One entry per file, or per skill listing and skill body, tagged with when the harness loads it: `start` (every model call pays for it), `lazy` (when the agent works in that subtree), `on demand` (when the agent invokes the skill) or `off` (a file the harness will not read). `totals` sums `chars` by `when`. Characters, not tokens: the token cost depends on the model.

kind.description: `import` is a file a CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md `@import`s; `rule` is a `.claude/rules/**/*.md` file, `start` at the root unless its frontmatter's `paths` names a pattern; a skill has a `skill listing` entry unless it is hidden from the model, and always a `skill body` entry.

chars.description: Characters in context; 0 for an unreadable file, which is also named in `warnings`.

skills.description: Project skills found, listed or not.

a.description: Skill name; its path when two skills share a name.

overlap.description: Jaccard index of the two descriptions' words with stop words removed, rounded to two places.

duplicate_skills.description: Pairs of listed skills with near-duplicate descriptions; the agent picks between them from the listing alone.

mcp_servers.description: Server names in the root .mcp.json, sorted; their tools are listed by the server at start-up and not counted.

warnings.description: What `repo budget --fail-on-warning` gates on: unreadable files, skills with no description, near-duplicate skills, AGENTS.md files turned off, imports past the harness's hop limit.
